<translated_code>
import sys

MOD = 1000000007

def power(a, b):
    return pow(a, b, MOD)

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.readline().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    p, k = map(int, data)
    if k == 0:
        result = power(p, p - 1)
    elif k == 1:
        result = power(p, p)
    else:
        ord = 1
        cur = k
        while cur != 1:
            cur = (cur * k) % p
            ord += 1
        result = power(p, (p - 1) // ord)
    print(result, end='')

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
